sentence: This project studies how cockatiels fly in turbulent air by measuring changes in their wing movements, metabolic activity, and group flight in a wind tunnel.
This project studies how local constraints in networks and families of finite sets affect their global structure.
This project studies how cells detect stresses, transfer and amplify stress signals, and change their physiology to adapt.
This project studies how bellflowers in the Mediterranean evolved and how geological history, hybridization, and human pressure shaped where they live.
This project builds and tests analytic metrology tools for chemical and biochemical problems raised by companies in several industries.
This project studies how colonial plantation agriculture changed the carbon stored in tropical soils on a Caribbean island.
This project studies how digital twins can teach holistic thinking about how decisions in one part of a building project affect building performance.
This project builds a method that mixes older mathematical insights with machine learning to predict how T cells respond to signals.
This project designs quantum databases that supply data to quantum processing units quickly and reliably.
This project builds curriculum modules that combine artificial intelligence and cybersecurity within computer science courses.
This project uses computer methods to find electrically-conductive metal-organic frameworks that can serve as cathode materials in lithium-sulfur batteries.
This project builds a compiler that automatically writes quantum programs able to keep working after errors and checks that they are correct.
This project builds a system that lets scientists analyze private data from several parties without sharing the data directly.
This project studies how the hormone aldosterone guides frogs as they change from life in water to life on land.
This project builds physical principles into deep learning models so they better predict the stability of solid-state inorganic materials.
